decisions.reason: As a recent, low-distance extension of the core offer, management is likely to keep it because it supports the service promise and any weak uptake can still be framed as a temporary ramp-up issue.

Although the seventy-two-hour promise is operationally demanding and thus more vulnerable than the other launches, the firm has already committed publicly to faster delivery and is likely to persist for another year rather than admit a misstep.
A fire-resistant steel exterior door fits the firm's safety-led core business, was highlighted prominently on the home page, and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.

Because this express program is a visible product line with several models and a page of its own, the firm has both invested in it and signaled commitment, which favors continued support despite any early frictions.

The online ordering and digital services platform matches the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support, and its sunk development costs make management likely to continue rather than reverse course quickly.

A fire and smoke protection door is close to the established safety and compliance business, so management is likely to retain it and interpret any initial disappointment as normal market adoption timing.
